name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month to choose a day from, or a range, several days, a month, quarter, half year or year: chosen units land into the switcher's thumb look, a range stretches one thumb across each week, months turn on the drum and the title opens months and years. DatePicker is a field you type a date into (read back as understood) or open the calendar from, with presets and Today.
base: table role=grid (the ARIA date grid pattern); Field, FormField and Popover
